title: STORY SERIES: REWINDING BREEZE OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY SERIES EVENT: REWINDING BREEZE OPEN
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Discarded Clock Dial, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: Rewinding Breeze event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Discarded Clock Dials from clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments in Flea Market. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories of current or past Vignette/Story Series.
★★★★★: Mint, Mint's Token, Information Fragments, Furniture Parts, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Intelligence. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Intelligence.
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Unfettered Magma", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Unfettered Magma", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Operator Mint is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Rewinding Breeze. Operator Mint is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Surtr, April, Mint, and Arene will gain more trust within this event
